[EN] Why is it every conversation about you has the word "corpse" in it?

It doesn't matter. The {@LinkCreature:22#28#dark prelates} and the {@LinkCreature:22#27#ensorceled disc reapers} are guarding the chapel. I think there's a link between their altar and what's happened here, so you're going to kill them.

These cultists are so over.
[ES] ¿Por qué cada conversación sobre ti tiene la palabra "cadáver" en ella?

No importa. Los {@LinkCreature:22#28#dark prelates} y los {@LinkCreature:22#27#ensorceled disc reapers} están custodiando la capilla. Creo que hay un vínculo entre su altar y lo que ha pasado aquí, así que vas a matarlos.

Estos sectarios son insoportables.

[EN] Thanks to you, the Scions of Lok have been crushed and this mindmagic thingy is weakened.

Now, perhaps, we can begin retaking our home. All thanks to me.

Well, and you.
[ES] Gracias a ti, los Scions of Lok han sido aplastados y esta cosa de magia mental está debilitada.

Ahora, tal vez, podamos empezar a recuperar nuestro hogar. Todo gracias a mí.

Bueno, y a ti.
